title: Ghost Forest
description: Forests were once found in abundance across Maryland's Eastern Shore. But due to its flat landscape, the area has been vulnerable to the effects of sea-level rise. The salinity of the soil has caused forests to massively decline, leaving behind "ghost forests" that are now ubiquitous across the Eastern Shore. Photographer Yazan Aboushi says his image captures the "haunting stalks that remain of what was once a thriving forest, now transitioning into marsh at Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge."
translated_description: 森林曾经在马里兰东海岸随处可见。但由于地势平坦，该地区一直容易受到海平面上升的影响。土壤的盐度导致森林大面积衰退，留下了如今在东海岸随处可见的“幽灵森林”。摄影师亚赞·阿布希说，他的照片捕捉到了“曾经繁茂的森林遗留下来的令人难忘的枯干，如今在布莱克沃特国家野生动物保护区正逐渐转变为沼泽”。
